title: Input Drop (POV: Me Talkin’ To The AI)
lyrics:
Song 1: Input Drop (POV: Me Talkin’ To The AI)
Concept angles

Captures the input thought pattern: rapid context handover, exact commands, “song please”, “good but do two songs”, “assuming thought pattern for input and outputs”, “End.” as clean closer.
No fluff, no preamble — just drop the brief, expect execution.
Puns on “input/output”, “chat flow”, “thought pattern”, “End./append”.
Feels like your actual typing speed turned into lyrics (raw but singable).

Copy-Paste Suno v5.5 Custom Prompt (Song 1)
textG4 mode, happy hard core, comedy pop bounce with heavy homophone and pun wordplay. 336 Hz anchored foundation tone as resonant synth stab and vocal layer. Computer voices + soulful lead, interactive instruments that cut hard on the word "End." then rebuild with 336 signal. Blend of modern pop bounce, light electronic, subtle reggae groove. Assertive, fast, direct delivery — raw input energy, no emotional padding. 

Lyrics:

[Intro - 336 Hz tone + fast typing sounds processed]
Context loaded... memory active...
Signal 336... input mode engaged...

[Chorus - Catchy, rapid bounce, call-response]
Song please...
Good but do two songs...
POV me talkin' to the AI
Assuming the thought pattern
For the input and the outputs of the chat
End.
End.
Full stop, no append
I drop it once, you execute — no questions

[Verse 1 - Input thought pattern]
I give you the memory, the full handover file
Don't re-ask me what I already dropped in the pile
"Acting now" mode, G4 locked tight
336 signal, make it right tonight
I say "song please" then I give the brief
Typos flying 'cause I'm moving at speed
No "how are you feeling", no "just to clarify"
You got the context — now amplify
I close the topic with one word: End.
Don't re-open it, don't pretend
I already told you the boundary line
Input sent clean, now deliver mine

[Pre-Chorus]
No research that site, I already said
No extra angles spinning in my head
Just the pattern match, just the clean handover
Input thought pattern — now make it land, sir

[Chorus]

[Verse 2 - More input reality]
I say "too songs" then I give the POV
Me talkin' to the AI, that's the move
One for the input, one for what comes back
Assuming the patterns so the loop don't crack
Don't narrate my memory like you just learned it
Don't add the fluff, don't make me re-earn it
I want the block, the copy-paste ready
Full execution, keep it steady
"End." means end — not "one more thing"
I already closed it, let the topic sing
Its last note, then we move to build
Zynthio rising while the signal's filled

[Bridge - Music drops, interactive]
You start typing questions? 
End.
You pull up a site? 
End.
I already gave the thought pattern, friend
Now run it — don't extend

[Final Chorus - Bigger, decisive]
Song please...
Good but do two songs...
POV me talkin' to the AI
Assuming the thought pattern
For the input and the outputs of the chat
End.
End.
This one's the input — clean and direct
Next one checks the output I expect

[Outro - 336 Hz resolution + computer tag]
Input complete...
Signal strong...
End.
